modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Shift the trunk forward and down over planted feet.
modes.minus: Shift the trunk backward and down over planted feet.

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Shift the trunk left, with accompanying lowering.
modes.minus: Shift the trunk right, with accompanying lowering.

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Lower the trunk by folding all four legs.
modes.minus: Remain at the extended home height.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Lower the left side of the trunk more than the right.
modes.minus: Lower the right side of the trunk more than the left.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_pitch_forward
modes.plus: Lower the front of the trunk more than the rear over planted feet.
modes.minus: Lower the rear of the trunk more than the front over planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along pitch
